description: List the Edgegap agent skills: tested, step-by-step workflows for getting a multiplayer game online on Edgegap, with templates (Dockerfiles, matchmaker configs, Unity C# and Unreal C++ drop-ins) and known pitfalls. Before working on a game project, load the matching skill with edgegap_get_skill: edgegap-fishnet for Unity with FishNet, edgegap-purrnet for Unity with PurrNet, edgegap-unity for other Unity projects, edgegap-unreal for Unreal Engine, edgegap-manus for a browser game built with Manus, edgegap for any other engine or platform questions; it routes to the rest. No API call.
name: edgegap_list_skills
title: List the Edgegap agent skills
